page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge is a high-performance GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates exactly one thread per core, ensuring dedicated, non-shared compute resources for demanding workloads.

The instance is equipped with four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, providing a total of 288 GB of VRAM. This hardware accelerator configuration is paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 6.0 GB per core. This dense allocation of high-bandwidth GPU memory and system RAM supports massive parallel processing tasks.

For connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 128 Gbps. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, as the instance is provisioned with 0 GB of local disk space, requiring external network-attached storage solutions. Additionally, the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the combination of 128 dedicated AMD EPYC cores and four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, this instance represents a high-density hardware class designed for massive computational workloads. It is highly suited for large-scale deep learning training, complex artificial intelligence inference, high-performance computing simulations, and parallel data processing pipelines.
